@graph.name: 195-Country Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) Tiers
@graph.description: Six global Purchasing Power Parity (PPP) pricing tiers mapped across all 195 sovereign countries using UN 2026 and World Bank FY27 GNI per capita classifications.

itemListElement.name: Tier 1: Developed Economies (100%)
itemListElement.description: Flagship: $3,000 USD | Individual Service: $300 USD | Extra Seat: +$300 USD

itemListElement.name: Tier 2: Upper-Middle Income Economies (75%)
itemListElement.description: Flagship: $2,250 USD | Individual Service: $225 USD | Extra Seat: +$225 USD

itemListElement.name: Tier 3: Lower-Middle Income Economies (50%)
itemListElement.description: Flagship: $1,500 USD | Individual Service: $150 USD | Extra Seat: +$150 USD

itemListElement.name: Tier 4: Startups & Founders (50%)
itemListElement.description: Flagship: $1,500 USD | Individual Service: $150 USD | Extra Seat: +$150 USD (open to early-stage companies in any country)

itemListElement.name: Tier 5: Academia & Non-Profits (25%)
itemListElement.description: Flagship: $750 USD | Individual Service: $75 USD | Extra Seat: +$75 USD (open to colleges, universities, and non-profits in any country)

itemListElement.name: Tier 6: Relief & Low-Income Economies (Custom)
itemListElement.description: Custom subsidized rate for low-income economies and crisis-affected regions
